ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio of low-intensity (dark grey/black) to high-intensity (white) pixels; surface area is approximately 95% low-intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Sparse, high-contrast white focal spots concentrated around the median notch and along the proximal edge of the right lobe; the majority of both lobes exhibit a continuous low-intensity (dark) mapping.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 105 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with variable pixel-amplitudes; multiple prominent triangular peaks and deep valleys are extracted along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory observed from the median notch extending to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (3-7 pixel diameter) located in the medial region near the notch and along the trailing edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography suggesting extensive historical tissue loss or wear; dense high-intensity pixel cluster at the distal tip of the right lobe consistent with barnacle attachment.
